0022600004.text: The Miami Heat host the Minnesota Timberwolves in both teams' first game of the 2026-27 season, and neither side has played yet this season. Miami's absences are Bam Adebayo (groin), Dru Smith (calf strain) and Pelle Larsson (illness), all listed as day-to-day, while Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo, who is out after Achilles surgery, and Rocco Zikarsky, who is day-to-day with an undisclosed reason. The Heat lost the 2025-26 season series 0-2, most recently a 122-94 defeat in Minneapolis on January 6, 2026.
